species: Proteome Discoverer 1.4 (Thermo Finnigan) coupled with the Sequest search engine and Uniprot database (Homo sapiens) was used for the analysis of the raw files.
tissue: For this purpose, decellularized human umbilical arteries (hUAs) may be proven as a significant source for the development of small diameter conduits.
sample_source: HUAs were isolated from hUCs (n = 10), that were delivered to the Hellenic Cord Blood Bank (HCBB).
age: HUCs were obtained from end term gestations (38–40 weeks), either with normal or caesarian delivery.
